description: Block Java serialized objects: base64 (rO0AB) or hex (aced0005, either case) forms.

Log PHP serialized objects: O: and C: (custom Serializable) forms, the tolerated O:+4: length sign, and namespaced classes (App\Models\...) -- modern gadget chains use namespaced classes, which the old \w+ could not match.

Log dangerous YAML language tags (!!python/object/apply:, !ruby/object:) anywhere in the value. The old ^\s*!\w+ was start-anchored and could not match the double-! form. Benign non-language tags like CloudFormation's !Ref do not match.
Log prototype-pollution keys; \s* before the colon closes the '"__proto__" :' spacing bypass.
